quests.name: Investigate the Scourge of Darnassus
quests.text: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Darnassus and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
notes: Only available during the Scourge invasion world event.

quests.name: The Temple of the Moon
quests.text: Sister Aquinne wants you to speak with Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon.

quests.name: The Sisterhood of Elune
quests.text: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.

quests.name: Vorlus Vilehoof
quests.text: Bring the Horn of Vorlus to Elanaria in Darnassus.

quests.name: The Shade of Elura
quests.text: Bring 8 loads of Elunite Ore and the Medallion of Elura to Elanaria in Darnassus.

quests.name: Smith Mathiel
quests.text: Bring the Case of Elunite to Smith Mathiel.

quests.name: Destiny Calls
quests.text: Find Sethir the Ancient and bring back any clues that you may discover to Syurna.

quests.name: Desperate Prayer
quests.text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

quests.name: Moonglade
quests.text: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

quests.name: Heeding the Call
quests.text: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.

quests.name: Body and Heart
quests.text: Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.  Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus when you are done.

quests.name: The Hunter's Path
quests.text: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

quests.name: Nessa Shadowsong
quests.text: Speak with Nessa Shadowsong.

quests.name: Eyes of the Sentinels
quests.text: Place Sentinel Owls at the entrance to the Cenarion Hold depths, the Darnassus Bank, the Craftsman's Terrace Inn, and the City Gate for Sentinel Dalia Sunblade in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

quests.name: Tears of the Moon
quests.text: Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon at Darnassus wants you to bring her Lady Sathrah's Silvery Spinnerets.

quests.name: Sathrah's Sacrifice
quests.text: Priestess A'moora wants you to place Lady Sathrah's silvery spinnerets at the fountain inside the temple, and then return to her.

quests.name: Trouble In Darkshore?
quests.text: Travel to Auberdine and look for signs of the dwarven excavation team.

quests.name: Lessons Anew
quests.text: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

quests.name: A Lesson to Learn
quests.text: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: Erion's Behest
quests.text: Travel to Stormwind City and seek council with Renzik "The Shiv."

quests.name: Grove of the Ancients
quests.text: Deliver Fandral's message to Onu in the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, south of Auberdine.

quests.name: Moonglow Vest
quests.text: Bring 1 Embossed Leather Gloves, 5 Embossed Leather Boots and 5 Embossed Leather Cloaks to Lotherias in Darnassus.

quests.name: A Lack of Fear
quests.text: Speak to High Priest Rohan in Ironforge.

quests.name: Arcane Feedback
quests.text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

quests.name: Contingency Plan
quests.text: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

quests.name: The Great Cat Spirit
quests.text: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: Sunscorched Shells
quests.text: Bring 20 Sunscorched Shells to Mathiel in Darnassus.

quests.name: Your First Feline Friend
quests.text: Inspect the riding sabers to choose your first mount.

quests.name: Learning to Ride
quests.text: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Jartsam.

quests.name: Assisting Arch Druid Staghelm
quests.text: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

quests.name: Un'Goro Soil
quests.text: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Jenal at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.

quests.name: Morrowgrain Research
quests.text: Take the Arch Druid's Seed Voucher to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.

quests.name: Morrowgrain Research
quests.text: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain.  Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.text: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: March of the Silithid
quests.text: Speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Calm Before the Storm
quests.text: Bring the Bank Voucher to Idriana in the bank of Darnassus.

quests.name: The New Frontier
quests.text: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.

quests.name: The New Frontier
quests.text: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.

quests.name: Rabine Saturna
quests.text: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.

quests.name: The Alliance Needs Your Help!
quests.text: Speak with Field Marshal Snowfall in Ironforge's Military Ward.

quests.name: Ten Commendation Signets
notes: The signets come only from the war effort supply quests, and this quest is tied to a world event.

quests.name: Dearest Colara,
quests.text: Deliver the Immaculate Letter to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.

quests.name: Dancing for Marzipan
quests.text: Do a dance emote at Innkeeper Saelienne, and in exchange you'll receive Darnassus Marzipan!
notes: This quest is only available during the Hallow's End holiday event.

quests.name: A Donation of Wool
notes: The cloth stays in your bags until you turn the quest in, and then it is handed over.

quests.name: Swift as the Wind
quests.text: Learn the Journeyman Riding skill from Jartsam.
